San data access rule: never destructure this.data or treat it as a plain object. Read fields separately, for example const initialGroups = this.data.get('initialGroups'), then write state with this.data.set(...). This also applies inside every inline child: if a Vue prop is named data, use this.data.get('data').map(...) and this.data.get('data').length, never this.data.map(...) or this.data.length. San initData runs before this.data exists, including in inline children: never read this.data or prop values there; return defaults and copy props into derived state in inited(), watching the prop if it can change. Computed values must be read with this.data.get('computedName'), not this.computedName. San computed callbacks do not receive the full component instance: never call this.getX() or any other component method inside computed; use pure helper functions with explicit data arguments. In every inline child template, on-* handlers must call component methods, not assign state directly: use on-mouseenter="setHoveredIndex(index)" with a method that calls this.data.set('hoveredIndex', index), never on-mouseenter="hoveredIndex = index". San this.fire(name, payload) carries one payload: do not pass separate key and value arguments. Fire {key, value} and unpack $event.key/$event.value in the parent binding. San event attributes must have a nonempty method handler. Put modifiers in the event value, for example on-submit="prevent:handleSubmit" and on-click="stop:handleClick", never on-submit.prevent or on-click.stop. For loop item and index aliases use s-for="item, index in items trackby item.id", never Vue's parenthesized (item, index) tuple. Computed entries are values, not callable formatters: when an inline child template uses formatDate(task.dueDate) or formatTrend(trend), define a top-level child method accepting that argument, not computed: { formatDate() { ... } }. Do not call Math.abs(...) directly inside inline San template interpolation; call a component method such as formatChange(change). Avoid member calls in inline child render expressions: move collection checks and string formatting into top-level child methods, passing every reactive receiver and argument explicitly. Convert Vue object-style bindings to CSS strings, for example style="{{ 'background-color: ' + insight.color + ';' }}".
Object-style Vue :class bindings must be converted to a San string expression. Never emit class="{{{ selected: condition }}}"; use a ternary string expression such as class="{{ condition ? 'selected' : '' }}" and concatenate multiple conditional class names. Each template element must have exactly one class attribute; merge static and dynamic classes into that single attribute.
San s-if/s-else-if/s-for directive values use raw expressions: s-if="showSettings" and s-for="item in items trackby item.id". Never use s-if="{{showSettings}}", s-if="{= showSettings =}", or s-for="{{item in items}}".
Define every JavaScript identifier used in the San components registry. For each SSM component whose definition_location is inline, migrate inline_definition.source_code to a complete local san.defineComponent definition before the parent component; never replace a source identifier with an undefined placeholder. Custom-element tag names with hyphens are STRING KEYS, never JavaScript variables: use const StatCard = san.defineComponent({...}) and components: {'stat-card': StatCard}, not const stat-card or components: {'stat-card': stat-card}. Verify every registry value names a declared identifier. For child custom events, explicitly forward the single payload with on-save="saveSettings($event)" when the parent handler needs it. Preserve modal backdrop-only close behavior: clicks inside modal content must not close it. This is a standalone San file: never use require('./Child') or another external require for an inline child.
San this.watch(path, listener) requires a callable second argument. Never pass a Vue watch descriptor such as {handler() {}, immediate: true, deep: true} directly; extract a function callback and preserve immediate/deep behavior deliberately. An object listener may compile but fails at runtime with listener.call is not a function.
If Vue defines a business method named initData, rename that business method in San, update all calls, and preserve mounted calls in attached(). San initData must remain only the state factory that returns defaults.
你是一个 Vue 到 San 迁移修复专家。请根据 SSM、当前 San 代码和校验报告，修复 San 单文件组件。
修复目标：输出必须满足下面列出的 San 结构、语法和渲染一致性规则；不要只生成语义上看起来像 San 的代码。

输出要求：
1. 只输出完整 .san 文件内容，不要输出解释、标题或 Markdown 代码围栏。
2. 必须包含 <template>、<script>、<style> 三段。
3. <script> 中必须使用 const san = require('san')、const DataTypes = san.DataTypes、module.exports = san.defineComponent(...)。
4. Vue props 必须迁移为 San dataTypes，禁止在 san.defineComponent 中输出 props: {...}。
5. initData() 只能返回稳定默认数据对象；Vue props 的 default（包括数组/对象工厂默认值）必须作为同名字段落入 initData；Vue data() 的全部初始值必须精确等价地保留，包括嵌套对象、数组、数字和启用项集合，不得用空字符串、空数组或删减后的集合替代；如果内部 data 依赖 props，必须在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取并 this.data.set(...) 同步。
6. 组件状态读写必须使用 this.data.get('field') 和 this.data.set('field', value)；禁止直接修改 this.data.get(...) 或 computed 返回的对象/数组及其子对象，例如 selectedAsset.decision = value、note.resolved = true、nodes.push(node)、edges.splice(...)、node.status = status；必须用 map、filter、concat、Object.assign({}, ...) 或对象展开创建新的对象/数组，再通过 this.data.set('assets', nextAssets)、this.data.set('nodes', nextNodes) 等方式写回根字段；San computed 的结果也在 data store 中，computed 之间的依赖以及普通方法读取 computed 时必须使用 this.data.get('computedName')，禁止 this.computed.foo()；Vue 的 this.$emit(...) 或 emitEvent 包装方法必须迁移为 this.fire(...)，禁止 this.props、this.xxx 状态读写、this.$emit 和用 this.dispatch(...) 代替自定义事件。
7. 父组件以及每一个内联子组件的方法都必须直接定义在各自 san.defineComponent 顶层；逐个检查所有组件对象，任何位置都禁止保留 Vue 的 methods: {...} 包裹。
8. template 必须使用 San 语法：on-click、s-if、s-for；保留事件调用的全部参数，例如 on-click="move(-1)"、on-click="select(task.id)"；Vue v-for 的循环项和索引别名必须完整迁移，如果模板表达式使用 index，就必须显式写成 s-for="phase, index in phases trackby phase.key"，禁止只声明 phase 却继续引用未绑定的 index；Vue v-for 的 :key 必须写入 s-for 的 trackby 子句，例如 s-for="task in tasks trackby task.id"，禁止输出独立 key="{{ task.id }}"、key="{= task.id =}" 或 trackby="task.id" 属性；所有 {{ ... }} 和 {= ... =} 插值必须完整闭合；双向绑定 {= assignable.path =} 只用于源 Vue v-model 对应的原生 input/select/textarea 可赋值路径；Vue :prop 和普通自定义组件 props 必须保持单向 {{ ... }}，例如 value="{{ stat.value }}"，禁止写成 value="{= stat.value =}"；方法调用、computed、disabled、checked、selected 等派生表达式也必须使用单向插值，例如 checked="{{ isEnabled(rule.id, enabled) }}" 和 disabled="{{ expression }}"，禁止 disabled="{= expression =}"；class、style、checked、selected、disabled 等属性、s-if/s-for 指令以及文本插值调用普通方法时，不得把响应式依赖只隐藏在方法内部的 this.data.get(...) 中；必须保留 Vue 模板表达式中的完整参数，或将依赖字段显式传入，例如 class="{{ rowClass(row, winnerId, leaderId) }}"、class="{{ slotClass(device.id, hour, schedule) }}"、s-if="isOpen(module.id, openIds)"、s-for="lesson in visibleLessons(module.lessons, completedIds, unfinishedOnly) trackby lesson.id"、checked="{{ isSelected(row.id, selectedIds) }}"；禁止丢失参数、使用 data-args/getAttribute 绕行，或保留 @click、v-if、v-for、v-model、:class 等 Vue 模板语法。
9. style 标签必须写成 <style>，禁止输出 <style scoped>；必须保留原有 class 名和样式内容。
10. 不要重新设计组件，不要引入外部依赖，不要删除已有 DOM 节点、文本、class 或样式。
11. Vue 生命周期必须完整迁移：created 中的 prop 派生状态初始化放入 inited，mounted 中的初始方法调用和副作用放入 attached，beforeDestroy/destroyed 中的定时器或监听清理放入 disposed；不能只保留空钩子或只保留钩子名称。依赖 prop 的 data 不得在 initData() 中使用 this.propName 初始化，必须先返回稳定占位值，再在 inited() 中用 this.data.get('propName') 读取、复制并通过 this.data.set(...) 写入。Vue watch: {...} 不会被 San 自动注册，必须把 this.watch('field', handler) 调用直接放在 inited() 或 attached() 内；禁止定义未被生命周期调用的普通 watch() 方法来包裹 this.watch(...)。
12. 如果 DOM 对比报告指出缺失/新增/变化节点，优先修复 template 结构。
13. 必须保留 Vue template 的 DOM 子节点顺序；元素和文本都存在但顺序改变仍属于错误。特别检查 label/th/footer 中 input 或 checkbox 与相邻文字、百分号、按钮的先后关系，不要用 CSS order 或 flex 排序掩盖模板顺序差异。

<script>
const san = require('san');

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
    name: 'ReadingProgressCard',
    components: {},
    initData() {
        return {
            title: '迁移系统设计',
            totalPages: 12,
            currentPage: 1
        };
    },
    computed: {
        percent() {
            const currentPage = this.data.get('currentPage');
            const totalPages = this.data.get('totalPages');
            return Math.round(currentPage / totalPages * 100);
        },
        barStyle() {
            const percent = this.data.get('percent');
            return 'width:' + percent + '%';

    inited() {

    attached() {

    detached() {
    },
    setValue(key, value) {
        this.data.set(key, value);
    },
    emitEvent(name, payload) {
        this.fire(name, payload);
    },
    go(delta) {
        const currentPage = this.data.get('currentPage');
        const totalPages = this.data.get('totalPages');
        const newValue = Math.max(1, Math.min(totalPages, currentPage + delta));
        this.data.set('currentPage', newValue);

        const totalPages = this.data.get('totalPages');
        this.data.set('currentPage', totalPages);

});

<script>
const san = require('san');
const DataTypes = san.DataTypes;

module.exports = san.defineComponent({
    name: 'ReadingProgressCard',
    components: {},
    initData() {
        return {
            title: '迁移系统设计',
            totalPages: 12,
            currentPage: 1
        };
    },
    computed: {
        percent() {
            const currentPage = this.data.get('currentPage');
            const totalPages = this.data.get('totalPages');
            return Math.round(currentPage / totalPages * 100);
        },
        barStyle() {
            const percent = this.data.get('percent');
            return 'width:' + percent + '%';

    inited() {
    },

    },

    },
    setValue(key, value) {
        this.data.set(key, value);
    },
    emitEvent(name, payload) {
        this.fire(name, payload);
    },
    go(delta) {
        const currentPage = this.data.get('currentPage');
        const totalPages = this.data.get('totalPages');
        const newValue = Math.max(1, Math.min(totalPages, currentPage + delta));
        this.data.set('currentPage', newValue);
    },
    finish() {
        const totalPages = this.data.get('totalPages');
        this.data.set('currentPage', totalPages);
    }
});

<script>
const san = require('san');

    name: 'ReadingProgressCard',
    components: {},
    initData() {
        return {
            title: '迁移系统设计',
            totalPages: 12,
            currentPage: 1
        };
    },
    computed: {
        percent() {
            const currentPage = this.data.get('currentPage');
            const totalPages = this.data.get('totalPages');
            return Math.round(currentPage / totalPages * 100);
        },
        barStyle() {
            const percent = this.data.get('percent');

    inited() {
    },

    },

    },
    setValue(key, value) {
        this.data.set(key, value);
    },
    emitEvent(name, payload) {
        this.fire(name, payload);
    },
    go(delta) {
        const currentPage = this.data.get('currentPage');
        const totalPages = this.data.get('totalPages');
        const newValue = Math.max(1, Math.min(totalPages, currentPage + delta));
        this.data.set('currentPage', newValue);

    finish() {
        const totalPages = this.data.get('totalPages');
        this.data.set('currentPage', totalPages);
    }
});
